title: Chapter 455: Ascends The Throne And Becomes Emperor
content:
Chapter 455: Ascends The Throne And Becomes Emperor

Wang Shuo shook his head in disappointment and arranged him.

Wang Shuo called Duan Wenxi, Chang Gui, Zhu Dongheng and others to discuss the matter.

"Everyone, what do you think we should do with the second prince?"

Wang Shuo told them in detail about the second prince's background. "What use can such a fool have?" Duan Wenxi said with some contempt.

Chang Gui said excitedly: "With the second prince, we can raise the flag and fight for territory legitimately."

Zhu Dongheng said: "Will it be too high-profile and cause a large number of other empires to attack?"

Wang Shuo was shocked and broke out in a cold sweat on his back when he heard it.

Now, the news of the second prince in the Dahuai domain will most likely be spread.

Because two of the strongest kings have escaped.

They were originally from the second prince's faction, but now it is hard to say.

If they tell the seventh prince's faction about this news, it will definitely be a great achievement.

Chang Gui was also terrified after listening to Zhu Dongheng's analysis.

"Before we are strong enough, we must not disclose this news."

Chang Gui turned his wooden head and changed his words.

"Indeed, it seems that the second prince is still a hot potato."

"Anyway, we should slowly accumulate strength!" Wang Shuo sighed.

Wang Shuo only hoped that Ayub and others would return as soon as possible.

A few days later.

Zhao Bangde and others returned.

Wang Shuo hurriedly asked about the situation.

Zhao Bangde shook his head and said helplessly: "I have seen Caiyi in the Warcraft Mountains, but I can't bring her back in her current state."

"In the depths of the Warcraft Mountains, her body can be frozen. If she is brought out, there is no way to revive her now."

"Old Zhao, you don't have to be sad. There will always be a decisive solution."

When Bing Fenghuang heard this, her heart trembled, and the temperature around her dropped by several degrees.

Wang Shuo glanced at her with ill intentions.

"Master, nothing else, I'll go back to the space first."

She wanted to escape from this place quickly, although she had an ostrich mentality.

Wang Shuo didn't want to use the life of the Ice Phoenix Emperor to exchange for the life of Ban Caiyi at this moment.

The Ice Phoenix Emperor could break through to the strongest king at any time, and he had made great efforts in several battles. Wang Shuo didn't want to be a person who would destroy the bridge after crossing the river.

In this way, more than ten days passed.

The preparations for the establishment of the empire have been completed.

On this day, the sky was clear and the weather was fine.

In Wana City, Wang Shuo's coronation ceremony and founding ceremony officially began.

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to choose Wana City as the capital. The name of the empire was Wana Empire.

The capital was chosen here mainly for safety.

The Great Wall of Steel is like the strongest barrier of the imperial capital.

In the future, the empire will continue to expand, and Tiexue Ridge may not necessarily be the center of the empire.

It is better to build the capital in the place Wang Shuo is most familiar with.

Festive music sounded.

Wang Shuo climbed the stairs.

At Wang Shuo's request, the enthronement ceremony was repeatedly simplified.

Wang Shuo came to the throne and turned around.

All the senior generals bowed and saluted to show their submission to the emperor.

Then, Duan Wenxi announced the important positions of the empire.

Zhao Bangde was appointed as the national teacher, Zhu Dongheng was appointed as the prime minister, Ayub was appointed as the general, Ye Tianba was the commander of the imperial guards, Duan Wenxi was the diplomatic envoy,...

All the important figures took up important positions.

Just when everyone in the hall was smiling.

Time suddenly seemed to stop.

Lord Zak, who had not appeared for a long time, suddenly appeared.
